label: copy-phase fed-back "3" just before "x" is output
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (97% of mass) when the fed-back input is the digit 3, and only from recall index 3 onward (none at recall 0-1, little at 2). The strongest activations come when the token being output right after that 3 is x (3 x in the original, e.g. d 3 3 x q -> [3:1.00]); 3 followed by x at recall_idx >= 3 is about 96% precise. Magnitude is clearly highest when out_tok is x, lower when next_out is x or out_tok is h. Weak activations (bottom quartiles) also occur on many other copy-phase 3 inputs (e.g. 3 then e, h, m), which accounts for the recall gap. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, never on first occurrences, and almost never on any input other than 3 (small residue on input x and h). Early-recall 3 -> x (recall_idx 1-2) is mostly inactive. Dev F1 0.61, mass recall 0.76, precision 0.79.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+8.40), next_out=x (+4.22), phase=2 & out_tok=x (+4.09), in_tok=3 (+4.01), phase=2 & in_tok=x (+3.84), out_tok=x (+3.84). Lower it: prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.65), recall_idx=1 (-3.65), to_go=6 (-2.58), orig5=k (-2.15).
